verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH client, and a product of this kind could plausibly offer a sandbox or test mode, so the axis applies. The pack only shows that vaults and groups can be organized by environment. That is an adjacent organizational control, not a product-provided sandbox that isolates testing from production data. missing for 10: a documented sandbox or isolated test environment, dry-run or simulated execution, and safeguards that keep AI-generated or broadcast commands off production hosts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Use them to separate data by team, project, or environment, and define who can access each vault.
